accent.from: colors.light.primary, palette, questions palette.rare, ia-notes Visual system as painted
accent.text: One hue. IA blue --primary is the only colour on a page; everything else is black, white and grey (--card, --border, --input, --text-secondary, --palette-gray-500, --ink-eyebrow). There is no second accent, no tinted section, no blue wash.

accent.from: colors.light.primary.from, colors.light.interactive, colors.light.brand-strong, ia-notes Visual system as painted
accent.text: Blue goes on: every text link (--interactive, chevron after it), the asterisk, the hairline over a we statement, the one Let's talk panel per page (--brand-strong), the selected service row, the contact form's pill, the focus ring (--ring). Count them: a page has a handful of blue moments, not a blue theme.

accent.from: ia-notes What would read as NOT IA, elements ia-logo and ia-asterisk rules, colors.light.heading
accent.text: Blue never goes on headings or display text (the framework table's element names are IA's one exception), behind a section, on the nav, on borders or dividers (except the we hairline), over a photo, on icons other than the chevron that follows a blue link, or on the logo, which is never recoloured, stretched, outlined or retyped. The asterisk is never placed on the blue panel.

accent.from: render home-close-r2, colors.light.brand-contrast, elements ia-logo-white rules
accent.text: On --brand-strong everything is --brand-contrast white: the question medium, the closer light, the arrow a white circle (recipe talk-panel) with a dark chevron. No asterisk, no blue link, no black logo, no second blue. If a mark is needed on blue or black, use ia-logo-white or ia-monogram-white.

accent.from: ia-notes Visual system as painted, render home-close-r2 footer
accent.text: Links: --interactive at rest with the chevron; on hover the whole link, chevron included, goes --foreground black. No underline, no lighter blue on hover. Footer links are --text-small, black, underlined. A list of links (We Deliver) is a stack of chevron links at --text-lead medium, never plain text.

Pill: --primary at rest, --primary-hover on hover, no lift or shadow; its 1px --ring focus sits --sp-hairline off the fill, because the ring is IA blue and needs that white gap to show on any blue. Circle buttons: --surface at rest, --canvas on hover, the same --ring focus. Inputs: --input hairline at rest, --ring hairline on focus (the form's focus:border-primary).

accent.from: elements chatbg and ia-blue-field-2 rules, brand.gradients
accent.text: The two blurred blue fields (chatbg, ia-blue-field-2) are IA's only gradients and they are image files: placed once as the ground of the conversational panel or a deck divider, bleeding off an edge. Text sits on the white side only; never behind running copy, never tinted or cropped to the blue. No coloured CSS gradient anywhere; linear-gradient only as the black photo scrim.

Grey carries hierarchy, not decoration: we in --palette-neutral-400, prose --text-secondary, meta --palette-gray-500, labels --ink-eyebrow, the panel ground --card, hairlines --border and --input. No grey text lighter than --palette-neutral-400 on white, except IA's own form labels and list numbers in --ink-eyebrow; nothing lighter than --palette-gray-500 on a grey panel.

accent.from: colors.light.inverse-surface, surfaces jewel-black, render home-close-r2, ia-notes Visual system as painted
accent.text: Black is the second surface: the Machine view page, the photo scrim, the chat pill (--prompt-bar, white text), the monogram circle. Black blocks carry white type (--inverse-foreground) and nothing else; never blue type on black.

accent.from: colors.light.chart-1, colors.light.chart-2, colors.light.chart-3, colors.light.chart-4, questions colors.light.semantic
accent.text: Charts: --chart-1 blue, --chart-2 black, --chart-3 grey, --chart-4 deep blue, in that order; --chart-5 only as a fifth series. No rainbow. Semantic colours (--destructive, --success, --warning, --info) are for form errors and system alerts only, never in editorial work or decks.

accent.from: modes.dark, modes.note, ia-notes What would read as NOT IA
accent.text: Light is IA. The Machine view and a quoted agent slide are drawn in light mode on --inverse-surface, never under .dark (dark turns --inverse-surface near-white). The .dark block is only for an embedded widget that follows the viewer's setting; never flip a page or deck to dark for mood.

accent.from: elevation, ia-notes Visual system as painted, render home-close-r2
accent.text: Photos are IA's own photography (the ia-studio and ia-work files), untinted and unfiltered; depth on photography is the black scrim (recipe image-card), not a shadow or a blue overlay. The only shadows: --sh-lg on image cards, --sh-sm on the chat pill and the mode tabs. Panels, nav, buttons and type sit flat on a hairline. The closer (Let's talk.) is light, never bold.

bans.from: fonts.sans, ia-notes What would read as NOT IA
bans.text: No serif type anywhere: headings, prose, captions, decks are all --font-sans. IA is one sans family.
bans.why: The site paints one family, Benton Sans; a serif reads as another firm.

bans.from: render about-we-r2, ia-notes What would read as NOT IA
bans.text: No left-border accent cards, quotes or callouts. IA's accent line is the hairline above a we statement; otherwise a full --border hairline.
bans.why: The left stripe is a generic template move; IA's only coloured rule runs on top.

bans.text: No radial gradients, glows or blurred blobs painted in CSS. IA's only soft blue fields are the two image files.
bans.why: The site has no CSS colour gradient; its atmosphere is photographic (chatbg, ia-blue-field-2).

bans.text: No Tailwind radial gradient utilities; same rule as no-radial-gradient.
bans.why: The site has no CSS colour gradient.

bans.text: No conic gradients, rings or colour wheels.
bans.why: Not in IA's vocabulary; charts are flat --chart-1 to --chart-4.

bans.text: No frosted glass. The floating nav, the mode tabs and the chat pill are solid surfaces with a hairline, not blurred.
bans.why: The nav reads as plain white with a border; glass is not in the capture.

bans.text: No Tailwind backdrop-blur utilities; same rule as no-backdrop-filter.

bans.from: questions palette.rare, questions colors.light.semantic, ia-notes Visual system as painted
bans.text: No second accent colour: no green, red, amber, purple or a lighter blue as decoration. Semantic colours are for form errors and system alerts only.
bans.why: One hue is the system; nine rare colours were dropped from the palette on purpose.

bans.text: The asterisk is one per page, slide or panel, on white or --card only. Never a bullet, list marker, divider, repeated pattern, watermark, background or anything on the blue panel.
bans.why: It marks the single statement that matters; repetition empties it.

bans.from: fonts.sans.italic, root.css --case-heading, type.eyebrow, ia-notes What would read as NOT IA
bans.text: No italic or all-caps headings, titles or display lines. Uppercase is the 12px eyebrow only (--text-micro, --case-eyebrow); italic only on a cited title inside prose.
bans.why: IA's headings are sentence case, upright (--case-heading none; the sans loads no italic).

bans.from: ia-notes What would read as NOT IA, brand.elements decorative-image, render home-statement-r2
bans.text: No illustration, 3D renders, icon grids, stock photography or tinted, filtered or blue-washed photos. IA's imagery is real fieldwork and studio photography, shown as shot.
bans.why: Client illustrations on the site are client work; IA's own imagery is photographic and untinted.

bans.from: modes.dark, modes.note, ia-notes What would read as NOT IA
bans.text: No dark page or dark deck by default. The derived dark block is for the Machine view, a quoted agent slide or an embedded widget.
bans.why: The site is light only; dark is derived by rule, not designed.

composition.from: spacing.page-max, spacing.gutter, spacing.band, spacing.stack, spacing.card-pad, ia-notes Layout
composition.text: Pages sit on --background white at --lay-page (1400px) with --lay-gutter (32px) sides. Sections are --sp-section (100px) of plain air apart: no coloured bands, no alternating grey stripes. Inside a section: --sp-stack-lg (40px) from heading row to content, --sp-stack-sm (24px) between items, --sp-inset-lg (24px) inside cards, --sp-region (48px) inside panels.

composition.from: ia-notes Layout, elements ia-asterisk rules, render home-statement-r2
composition.text: A section opens with a heading row: the marked statement (recipe asterisk-heading: a typed bold * in --primary tucked --sp-optical before a --text-h2 36px medium line in --ink-heading) left and at most one blue chevron link (recipe chevron-link, e.g. See More Results) right, then the content below. One marked statement per view.

composition.from: type.display-1, type.heading-1, type.heading-2, type.heading-3, type.lead, type.body, type.small, type.eyebrow, fonts.sans
composition.text: One family, --font-sans. Ladder: --text-display 60 bold, white over photography only; --text-h1 48 bold page titles; --text-h2 36 medium statements and section heads; --text-h3 30 bold sub-sections; --text-lead 20/1.625 prose; --text-body 16 UI and list rows; --text-small 14 meta and footer; --text-micro 12 uppercase only for form labels and list numbers, in --ink-eyebrow.

composition.from: colors.light.text-secondary, type.lead, render article-r2, ia-notes Name and voice
composition.text: Long-form copy is --text-lead in --text-secondary on white, running the page container as IA's articles do. First person plural. Titles of pages, articles, services and decks are Title Case with no full stop; statements (the marked line, section intros, we lines, card lines) are sentence case ending in a full stop. No emoji, no eyebrow above a title. Headings stay --ink-heading black.

composition.from: radius.containers, radius.inputs, radius.controls, colors.light.card, lines.card-border, spacing.grid, ia-notes Visual system as painted
composition.text: Every container is --r-containers (14px): cards, panels, photos, the hero, the nav. Grey panels are --card with a --stroke-hairline --border edge; white cards get the same hairline; both sit flat. Grids run three across at --sp-stack-sm gaps; split panels are 3fr 2fr. Inputs are --r-lg (10px), controls --r-md (8px); --r-chip is reserved for the primary pill, the chat input and circle icon buttons.

composition.from: render home-close-r2, colors.light.brand-strong, ia-notes Visual system as painted
composition.text: Home and section pages close with the same pair at --sp-stack-sm gap: the conversational panel (recipe chat-panel, chatbg ground) left and wider, the one blue Let's talk panel (recipe talk-panel) right, then the footer (recipe site-footer). An article closes with the closing-action button and the footer only, no pair.

composition.from: elements ia-insight-to-action rules, type.display-1, ia-notes Visual system as painted
composition.text: Heroes are IA's own photography at --r-containers, the full width of --lay-page. The home hero carries the Insight to Action lettering (ia-insight-to-action, white) across the full width with a hairline and a --text-small caption under it. Inner-page heroes centre the title at --text-display, white, on the black scrim. No blue on a hero, no asterisk on a photo.

composition.from: render home-statement-r2, elevation, brand.elements lucide-a2d4, findings roles h3
composition.text: Case studies and insights are photo tiles (recipe image-card): a black scrim rising from the bottom and a bold white title bottom-left, no eyebrow; --sh-lg, --r-containers, portrait 4:5. A row scrolls sideways with two circle chevron buttons (recipe circle-button) beneath it, left-aligned. The title is always bold.

composition.from: render about-we-r2, ia-notes Name and voice, colors.light.text-secondary
composition.text: The manifesto is a three-column grid of we statements (recipe we-statement): a --primary hairline on top, we in --palette-neutral-400 at --text-h2 regular, the claim bold in --ink-heading at the same size, then a paragraph in --text-secondary. Lowercase we, a full stop, no asterisk, no icon. Rows sit --sp-section apart, columns --sp-stack-lg.

composition.from: ia-notes Name and voice, colors.light.brand-strong, type.heading-3
composition.text: Services are a numbered list (recipe service-list): rows at --text-body medium, the number (01. to 04.) at --text-micro in --ink-eyebrow, a chevron at the end, --r-containers corners, no hairlines. The one selected row is a solid --primary block with --primary-foreground text; hover draws an --input edge and turns the text blue.

composition.from: root.css [data-deck], elements ia-logo and ia-monogram rules, ia-notes Visual system as painted
composition.text: Decks keep the grammar at the [data-deck] scale: white slides, bold --text-h1 Title Case titles, one marked statement slide in medium weight, IA's studio photography at --r-containers, a blue Let's talk closing slide, ia-logo on the cover and close, ia-monogram small in a corner of content slides. One blue element per slide; a dark slide only to quote the Machine view.

composition.from: render article-r2, elements ia-insight-to-action-black rules, controls.button-height
composition.text: Articles open with a full-width photo or diagram at --r-containers, then the --text-h1 Title Case title, then text across the container on the same left edge. Full-width --border hairlines split sections; each opens with a --text-h3 topic word over its question at the h3 weight. The closing-action button ends it. One-pagers open with ia-logo and the title; the lettering is the home hero only.

composition.from: fonts.mono, ia-notes Visual system as painted
composition.text: The Machine view is the one black page: --inverse-surface ground, --font-mono lines at --text-small padded to double leading in --palette-neutral-400, markdown-like prefixes (hash, greater-than, double hash) dimmer in --palette-neutral-600. It is IA's page for agents; --font-mono appears nowhere else.

composition.from: radius.controls, radius.inputs, lines.focus, colors.light.ring, colors.light.input, findings states
composition.text: Anything interactive (menus, dialogs, selects, tabs, popovers, tooltips, toggles) comes from the shadcn/ui components in components/ui, dressed by the tokens: --r-controls on controls and tabs, --r-lg on inputs with an --input hairline, overlays on --surface at --r-containers with --sh-sm, focus ring --ring 1px, no offset except on a blue fill (--sp-hairline there).

composition.from: controls.button-height, controls.button-pad-x, type.button, findings roles button
composition.text: The closing action of a page or article is the near-black button (recipe closing-action): --palette-neutral-900, --r-lg, --ctl-md tall, --text-body regular white. The blue pill (recipe pill-action) is the contact form's submit only. Secondary actions are blue chevron links. Icon-only actions are circle buttons (recipe circle-button): --surface, --input hairline, one Lucide chevron or arrow.

composition.from: findings roles nav, render article-r2, elements ia-logo rules
composition.text: The nav is a compact white pill centred near the top, about 330px wide, floating over the hero's top edge: --surface, --stroke-hairline --border, --r-containers, ia-logo left at 24px or taller, one menu button (Lucide equal, two lines) right that opens the menu as a panel; no text links. IA's Classic, Agentic and Machine tabs belong to IA's own site articles only.

items.name: IA asterisk
items.use: IA's signature mark, in two forms. On a statement: a typed bold * in --primary at the statement's own size, tucked --sp-optical before its first word (recipe asterisk-heading); the glyph, not this file. Large: this six-spoke file as the one 60px corner mark (--text-display) top-right of a grey panel (recipe statement-panel), a CSS mask filled with --primary. One per page, slide or panel. On white or --card only; never on the blue panel, a photo or black; never a bullet, pattern or background.

items.name: IA Collaborative logo
items.use: The primary lockup, black ink baked in. The nav (left, 24px tall or more), a deck's title and closing slides, the one-pager masthead. On --background or --card only; clear space of the monogram's height on all sides; never recoloured blue, stretched, outlined or retyped. Place inline as an img tag at a fixed height, never as a mask.

items.name: IA logo, white
items.use: The same lockup with white ink; the letters stay cut out so the ground shows through. For the blue panel, black bands, the Machine view and dark photography where white reads 4.5:1 or better. Same clear space and minimum size as the black logo.

items.name: IA monogram
items.use: The circle monogram alone, black. The chat avatar (recipe chat-panel, masked in --foreground at --ctl-sm), favicon, slide footer corner, a sign-off beside text that already says IA Collaborative. Light grounds only. Smallest 16px.

items.name: IA monogram, white
items.use: The monogram with white ink, for IA blue, black and photographic grounds only. Smallest 16px.

items.name: Insight to Action lettering
items.use: The brand line as drawn lettering, white. Full width of the home hero over photography or film, a hairline and a --text-small caption under it. Once, at the top of a page or as a deck's opening slide. Never in body copy, never retyped; inline as an img at full measure.

items.name: Insight to Action lettering, black
items.use: The same lettering in black for white grounds: the cover of a brand piece or a white opening slide, once, at full measure, on --background or --card only. Not a masthead for documents or one-pagers, which open with ia-logo and their own title.

items.name: Blue field (chat ground)
items.use: The soft blue field behind the conversational panel (recipe chat-panel: background-image, cover, centred). Place once inside one surface, the blue mass low and off an edge; copy sits on the white side; never tiled, never behind running text, never cropped to the blue.

items.name: Blue field 2 (divider ground)
items.use: The wide blur of IA blue rising from the lower left into white. The ground of one quiet panel, a deck cover or a deck's section divider, full bleed, once per page or deck section. Black text on the white side only; never tinted, never cropped to the blue, never behind body copy.

items.name: Asterisk-marked heading
items.use: The marked statement of a section or slide: a typed bold * in --primary, --sp-optical before an --text-h2 medium line. One per view.

items.name: We statement
items.use: The About manifesto unit: --primary hairline, grey we, bold claim, grey paragraph. Three across on the About page; one alone as a deck slide or a one-pager pull.

items.name: Grey statement panel
items.use: The IA means Insight to Action panel: --card ground, --border hairline, --r-containers, the asterisk as a 60px corner mark, a --text-h2 title, a 3fr 2fr body of prose and a labelled list of chevron links.

items.name: Let's talk panel
items.use: The single blue panel per page: a white --text-h2 medium question, the closer Let's talk. at the same size in light, a white circle arrow. The whole panel links to Contact.

items.name: Blue chevron link
items.use: Every text link: --interactive medium with a Lucide chevron-right after it, hover to black. The right side of a heading row (compact) and the We Deliver list (lead size).

items.name: Pill primary action
items.use: The contact form's submit and the chat send: an IA-blue pill, white medium label, --ctl-md tall. Not the closing Let's talk.

items.name: Image card
items.use: Case-study and insight tiles: a photo under a black scrim with a bold white title bottom-left, no eyebrow; --sh-lg, --r-containers.

items.name: Numbered service list
items.use: IA's services as on its services page: rows at --text-body medium, small grey numbers, a chevron, no hairlines; the selected row solid --primary.

items.name: Conversational panel
items.use: The chat invitation at the foot of a page: chatbg as ground inside a --r-containers surface, monogram avatar, bold greeting, grey text, a black --r-chip input with a grey send circle. Left of the blue panel.

items.name: Circle icon button
items.use: Icon-only control: white --r-chip circle, --input hairline, one Lucide chevron or arrow in --foreground. Under scrolling rows (prev, next) and anywhere a small directional control is needed.

items.name: Site footer
items.use: The last line of every page: --border hairline on top, --text-small, company line left, underlined links right. Nothing else below the blue panel.

items.name: Closing action
items.use: The closing Let's talk of a page or article: near-black --palette-neutral-900, white regular label, --ctl-md tall, --r-lg corners. One per view.

items.name: Framework table
items.use: A named framework as IA's own IDEALS table: a small bold black label, then rows of a blue name with a bold initial beside its question, key phrases bold.

items.name: Studio, open plan
items.use: IA's Chicago studio, wide and calm: a deck cover, an About section, the top of a one-pager. IA's own photography: untinted, in a --r-containers frame, white type only on the black scrim. Lead a deck, page or one-pager with one.

items.name: Studio, team at work
items.use: IA's team at a long table by the studio windows: insight and capability pages, a how-we-work slide. IA's own photography: untinted, in a --r-containers frame, white type only on the black scrim. Lead a deck, page or one-pager with one.

items.name: Studio, project room
items.use: A project room seen through glass, prototypes beyond: a section divider, a page about craft. IA's own photography: untinted, in a --r-containers frame, white type only on the black scrim. Lead a deck, page or one-pager with one.

items.name: Studio, model shop
items.use: IA's prototyping shop: product and experience work, a 'start making' line. IA's own photography: untinted, in a --r-containers frame, white type only on the black scrim. Lead a deck, page or one-pager with one.

items.name: Work, synthesis wall
items.use: IA's team at a synthesis wall, a wide panorama: a page or section hero, a wide slide band. IA's own photography: untinted, in a --r-containers frame, white type only on the black scrim. Lead a deck, page or one-pager with one.

items.name: Work, side by side
items.use: Two IA designers working side by side: a we-statement row, an article about how IA works. IA's own photography: untinted, in a --r-containers frame, white type only on the black scrim. Lead a deck, page or one-pager with one.

items.name: Work, research review
items.use: An IA team reviewing research on a wall of notes: an insights article, a capabilities page. IA's own photography: untinted, in a --r-containers frame, white type only on the black scrim. Lead a deck, page or one-pager with one.

observed.summary: Ground --background white, ink --foreground black. One hue, IA's own --color-primary token, now --primary, --brand-strong, --interactive and --ring. Prose --text-secondary (About) and --palette-neutral-700 (article), meta --palette-gray-500, labels --ink-eyebrow, panel --card with --border, inputs --input. Nine rare Tailwind colours and the pale semantic tints were dropped; --destructive kept for forms. No dark scheme on the site; dark is derived by rule.

One family, Benton Sans, loaded as a web font (licensed); Libre Franklin stands in at 86% letter-shape match, 300/400/500/700. Heading tracking loosened 0.01 to 0.015em so the stand-in sets at IA's width. Ladder 60/48/36/30/20/16/14/12: display and h1 bold, h2 medium, h3 bold, micro medium uppercase. Two gaps: IA's 24px step (card titles) and the light 300 closer have no token. JetBrains Mono 14/28 only in the Machine view.

Lucide, 2px stroke, chevrons and arrows only: chevron-right after every blue link (16px inline, 24px in lists), white 24px chevrons on the image cards, chevron-left and chevron-right in 36px circle buttons under rows, arrow-up in the chat send, pause on the hero film. Icon ink follows the text it sits with. No icon grids, no filled or duotone icons, no decorative icons; the only marks are IA's own asterisk, monogram and logo.

The site's shadcn ladder 6/8/10/14 from --radius .625rem: controls 8 (mode tabs, See More Results), inputs 10 (contact form), containers 14 (cards, panels, photos, nav). The pill (9999) is IA's primary action, chat input and circle icon buttons; read as a brand rule (--r-chip), not the controls radius, so the numeric ladder stays. Corners are plain arcs.

1px hairlines, never heavier: --border on cards, panel edges and the footer top; --input on form fields; the circle buttons' gray-300 reads as --input. One accent line in the system: a 1px --primary rule over each we statement. Focus on the site is a 1px grey outline with no offset; re-aimed to --ring (IA blue) from the form's focus:border-primary. No divider rules between sections; air does that.

Page --lay-page 1400 with --lay-gutter 32; sections --sp-section 100 apart; stack --sp-stack-lg 40; grid gap and card pad 24 (--sp-stack-sm, --sp-inset-lg); panels about 48 (--sp-region). Controls 48 tall (--ctl-md: submit, Let's talk button, inputs, chat pill); circle buttons 36. Spacing derives from the 16px body. The twins read a touch tighter than the site at 20px prose; the --ms-md measure keeps article lines at IA's length.

Flat by default: panels, nav, buttons and inputs carry a hairline and no shadow. Two shadows read on the site: shadow-sm (--sh-sm) on the chat pill and the mode tabs; shadow-lg (--sh-lg) on the case-study image cards. Depth on photography is a black 70% scrim, never a shadow or tint. The 26 gradient paints are the two blue field images and the scrims; there is no coloured CSS gradient anywhere.

stance.from: ia-notes Name and voice; colors.light.primary; render home-close-r2, about-we-r2
stance.summary: White pages, black type, one blue. IA speaks in plain first-person statements, marks the one that matters with an asterisk, shows real fieldwork photography, and asks one question per page in a single blue panel. Everything else is grey, flat and quiet.
